# Orange Logic

> Orange Logic provides enterprise digital asset management (DAM) and media asset management (MAM) software for organizations with complex content libraries, workflows, governance requirements, integrations, and global teams. Its platform supports content orchestration, AI-assisted asset management, metadata and taxonomy, workflow automation, digital rights management, brand portals, enterprise search, security, and scalable content operations.

Use the resources below to understand Orange Logic, its platform capabilities, industry applications, customer outcomes, technical documentation, and third-party analyst recognition.

## Company and Platform

- [Orange Logic](https://www.orangelogic.com/): Overview of Orange Logic and its enterprise digital asset management platform, including configurable team workspaces, content orchestration, AI-assisted asset management, governance, security, integrations, and scalable content operations.
- [About Orange Logic](https://www.orangelogic.com/About): Company background, mission, purpose, and history of Orange Logic, an enterprise digital asset management provider founded to solve complex digital archive and content management challenges for global organizations.
- [Enterprise Digital Asset Management Platform](https://www.orangelogic.com/digital-asset-management-software): Overview of Orange Logic's enterprise DAM platform for centralizing digital assets, connecting teams and workflows, improving search and discovery, managing usage rights, supporting media production, and scaling content operations across an organization.
- [Media Asset Management Platform](https://www.orangelogic.com/media-asset-management): Overview of Orange Logic's media asset management capabilities for storing, searching, editing, reviewing, transcoding, collaborating on, and distributing large video and rich-media files within an integrated DAM environment.

## Core Capabilities

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/artificial-intelligence): Explanation of Orange Logic's AI capabilities for asset discovery, automated tagging and metadata enrichment, content generation, transcription, facial and object recognition, rights enforcement, and workflow automation within the DAM.
- [Metadata and Taxonomy](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/metadata-taxonomy): Overview of tools for creating and managing enterprise metadata models, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, automated tags, and asset relationships to improve content organization, findability, governance, and automation.
- [Workflows and Automation](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/workflows): Overview of configurable project workflows for coordinating tasks, asset production, reviews, approvals, notifications, and automated actions while keeping work, content, and project status connected within the DAM.
- [Digital Rights Management](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/digital-rights-management): Explanation of Orange Logic's integrated digital rights management capabilities for recording usage terms, tracking expirations, managing talent and licensing rights, controlling downloads, applying watermarks, and preventing unauthorized asset use.
- [Brand Portals](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/brand-portals): Overview of customizable, branded portals for giving employees, partners, agencies, distributors, and other audiences controlled access to approved assets, brand guidelines, templates, and content collections.
- [DAM Security and Compliance](https://www.orangelogic.com/features/dam-security-compliance): Overview of Orange Logic's enterprise security, privacy, governance, and compliance capabilities, including access controls, permissions, authentication, auditability, secure asset sharing, infrastructure protections, and relevant certifications.

## Content Operations and Search

- [Content Orchestration vs. Traditional DAM](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/content-orchestration-vs-dam): Explanation of how content orchestration extends traditional DAM by connecting people, assets, workflows, systems, governance rules, approvals, distribution, and performance information across the complete content lifecycle.
- [Content Repurposing in Digital Asset Management](https://www.orangelogic.com/repurposing-in-digital-asset-management): Guide to using DAM technology to find, adapt, version, localize, govern, and redistribute existing content so organizations can extend asset value, reduce duplicated production, and support more channels and audiences.
- [AI Search in DAM](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-content/ai-search-in-dam): Guide to AI-powered DAM search using natural-language processing, vector embeddings, automated metadata, multilingual discovery, and multimodal analysis to locate relevant images, documents, and specific moments within video.
- [Agentic AI and Content Operations](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/what-does-agentic-ai-mean): Explanation of agentic AI in content operations, including how autonomous AI agents can interpret goals, use organizational context, perform multistep work, apply brand and rights rules, and coordinate processes across the content lifecycle.

## Industry Solutions

- [DAM for Retail, CPG, and Food and Beverage](https://www.orangelogic.com/retail-cpg-fb-dam-solutions): Overview of DAM capabilities for retail, apparel, consumer packaged goods, and food and beverage organizations, including product-content management, PIM integration, packaging governance, SKU-level organization, omnichannel distribution, brand control, and campaign production.
- [DAM for Manufacturing](https://www.orangelogic.com/manufacturing-dam-solutions): Overview of DAM applications for manufacturers managing product imagery, technical documentation, marketing materials, product data, regional variations, partner distribution, approvals, brand consistency, and content across the product lifecycle.
- [DAM for Media and Entertainment](https://www.orangelogic.com/industries/media-entertainment): Overview of DAM and media asset management capabilities for broadcasters, publishers, studios, sports organizations, and other media companies managing large video libraries, production workflows, archives, metadata, rights, collaboration, and distribution.

## Buying and Evaluation Resources

- [The 2026 Enterprise DAM Buyer's Guide](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-content/the-2026-dam-buyers-guide-orange-logic): Evaluation guide for defining DAM requirements, assessing organizational readiness, comparing platform capabilities, involving stakeholders, evaluating vendors, and selecting a DAM suited to an organization's teams and use cases.
- [Adobe AEM DAM Alternatives](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/adobe-aem-alternatives): Comparison guide to digital asset management alternatives to Adobe Experience Manager Assets, covering selection considerations such as configurability, scalability, integrations, implementation, usability, governance, artificial intelligence, and total platform requirements.

## Customer Evidence

- [Orange Logic Customer Case Studies](https://www.orangelogic.com/case-studies): Collection of customer stories showing how organizations across media, retail, technology, cultural institutions, education, nonprofit, and other sectors use Orange Logic to manage content, improve workflows, increase findability, govern assets, and support enterprise-scale operations.

## Analyst Recognition

- [Forrester Wave Leader for DAM, Q1 2026](https://www.orangelogic.com/a-forrester-wave-leader-dam-2026): Summary of Orange Logic's recognition as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Digital Asset Management Systems, Q1 2026, including information about the evaluation and access to the associated report.
- [Frost Radar Leader for DAM, 2025](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-leader-in-frost-sullivans): Summary of Orange Logic's placement as a Leader in the 2025 Frost Radar for digital asset management, covering the company's positioning in the analysis of innovation and growth.
- [Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for DAM, 2025](https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/leader-dam-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant): Summary of Orange Logic's recognition as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Asset Management Platforms, including the company's interpretation of its positioning and the report's DAM market evaluation.

## Developer Documentation

- [OrangeDAM Developer Portal](https://developer.orangelogic.com/): Technical documentation for developers integrating with or extending OrangeDAM, including information about its APIs, authentication, endpoints, data structures, requests, responses, and supported integration workflows.

    High-volume environments demand speed and reliability that never waver. Orange Logic is engineered for growing content libraries, advanced workflows, and expanding integration needs.

    AI FOR WHAT’S NEXT

    Orange Logic is the agentic orchestration layer for your content ecosystem. At its core is an Agentic DAM: a system where content, context, and intelligence come together and AI operates across your workflows, tools, and teams. With Orange Logic, you can design, deploy, and orchestrate

    • Coordinate tasks across systems and teams

    • Continuously optimize how content is created, managed, and delivered
